evidence_set: Up to 75% of rave attenders used several substances, with an average of five drugs at the last rave attended (ref. 12, a cluster analysis of underground rave attenders); polysubstance use in club and dance venues is described as widespread. A small sedative-and-alcohol class had last-year prevalence of 1.3% among young Australian adults (ref. 22).

Reasons for Use, 2nd paragraph (p. 270, right column); Prevalence and the Current Patterns of Multiple Substance Use, 4th paragraph, last sentence (1.3%) and 5th paragraph, last sentence (club and dance venues) (p. 271, right column); reference list, ref. 12 (p. 274)
